name: Shoujo-tachi wa Kouya o Mezasu
original_name: 少女たちは荒野を目指す
source:
Buntarou doesn’t know what he wants to do in the future, he does not have any kind of dream that he wants to pursue. So currently he just spends his days hanging around with his friends. When one day his classmate Sayuki asks him if he wants to help with development of a galge. She says that she had become interested in his help after she read one his works intended for the drama club.

Buntarou doesn’t know anything about gal games but Sayuki claims that she has the ability to make it a success. Can they make the game and will it be a success like she claims it will be? This is the story of youths taking a daring step into the unknown…

[From [url=http://www.otakulair.com/news/japanese-visual-novels/cast-revealed-for-shoujo-tachi-wa-kouya-wo-mezasu-by-minato-soft/]OtakuLair[/url]]

First project in the Takahiro IV series. New Visual Novel by Tanaka Romeo and Matsuryuu, the team responsible for Cross+Channel.
translation:
文太郎不知道自己将来想做什么，也没有任何想要追逐的梦想。因此，目前他只是和朋友们一起消磨时光。一天，同班同学砂雪问他愿不愿意帮助开发一款美少女游戏。她说，自己在读过他为戏剧社创作的作品后，便对他的帮助产生了兴趣。

文太郎对美少女游戏一无所知，但砂雪声称自己有能力让游戏取得成功。他们能完成这款游戏吗？游戏真的会像她说的那样大获成功吗？这是一个年轻人勇敢迈入未知领域的故事……

[来自[url=http://www.otakulair.com/news/japanese-visual-novels/cast-revealed-for-shoujo-tachi-wa-kouya-wo-mezasu-by-minato-soft/]OtakuLair[/url]]

《少女们向荒野进发》系列“高桥IV”企划的第一部作品。由《Cross+Channel》的制作团队田中罗密欧与松龙创作的新视觉小说。
